buyer_added_terms.text: ेेतताा ाारराा जजोोड़ड़ गगईई बबडड कक ववशशेषेष शशतत

1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses (A) Works Schedule: - 1 The contractor has to supply 1 MT loading capacity vehicle i.e. Mahindra Bolero Camper Gold Zx or equiv alent truck for carrying railway materials over the jurisdiction of SSE/PSI/CKP for two years under Sr. DEE/T RD/CKP in all 07 (seven) days of a week with the Consignee at Railway premises or at any other place as n ominated by Railways. 2 The Truck with loading capacity of 1 MT and running up to 1500 km per month (with 24 hrs. availability) f or loading of Elect (TRD) materials and men as desired by Engineer - in- charge. It includes cost of driver, h elper, fuel / lubricants, running repairs, servicing, vehicle accessories, major / minor repairs, overhauling a nd servicing, maintenance of the vehicle and the Octroi toll tax as and when required etc. it shall also inclu de all type of taxes as admissible by State or Central Governments, octroi, toll tax, barrier tax etc. Vehicle shall run on pucca, kutcha road including along the track. The contractor shall arrange road permit for vehi cle for all the States of operation as per instructions of Engineer in-charge and vehicle shall not be more th an three years old. 3 The vehicle should be always full of consumables and fuel at any given moment for movement of vehicle to farthest corner of this Division and return. The vehicle should be fit in all respect to cover tedious journ ey on any type of road. The vehicle must be provided with one spare wheel in fit condition with necessary tools for emergency rep airs. 4 The vehicle should reach at any other places as required by Railways at the shortest possible time when ever advised to do so. The vehicle will be required to move round the clock and to any directions; as such the driver should be fully aware of road of Odisha, Jharkhand and West Bengal. 5 The materials to be loaded in the vehicle shall be at the discretion of the Railway Authorities and the con tractor / Driver shall have no right to refuse / deny any material allowed by Railway Authorities to be loade d in Vehicles. 6 In case of any unfortunate accident of coaching train involving casualties, the vehicle may be utilized for carrying injured persons and / or dead bodies. The Contractor / Driver shall not object to such utilization of vehicle. 7 At the time of major repair, break down en-route or any other repairs when the vehicle is not available, a lternate similar vehicle which fulfills all required condition may be arranged by the tenderer within 02 (two ) hours. 8 The Contractor will have to supply the road vehicle to the Railway on service start date. The vehicle will work in all climatical conditions. 9 The vehicles will run approximately 1500 Kms. per month. Any less utilization on monthly basis in any m onth i.e. less than 1500 km / month will be carried forwarded to the next months. Similarly, any extra km i s utilization if any, will be carried forwarded / adjusted in the next months. 10 In case the vehicle is detained out of station overnight, the railway will provide no accommodation & no night duty allowance nor any compensation or whatsoever for driver and contractor. 11 Payment of hire charges will be made quarterly after due verification of logbook as necessary by the Ra ilway official by NEFT/RTGS, based on the total km run by vehicle during each month after due verification of log book and necessary certification by SSE/PSI/CKP the In-charge of depot.

12 Minimum wages to the driver and other statutory obligation should be met by the contractor at his own cost. Payment of driver should be made in bank account only. Photo copy of the pass book must be produc ed at the time of quarterly payment. in case of failure to produce passbook then 60% payment will be mad e of the bill of that month. 13 The driver should have the valid driving license and Commercially Registered vehicle should be insured against Accident etc. as per rules and statutory obligations. 14 The quantities mentioned in the tender schedule are only approximate and may vary according to actu al requirement up to 25% on either side at same rate, terms and conditions. 15 Driver must always carry his own Driving license. 16 The Commercially Registered vehicle provided will be solely for the use of railway officials and cannot b e used by the contractor or any other purpose/commercial use. 17 “Govt. of India” board should be fixed on the Commercially Registered vehicle prominently. 18 It is the responsibility of the contractor for validation/revalidation of the certificates mentioned above d uring the currency of the contract. 19 No extra payment shall be made on account of increase/decrease in the rate of Fuel, lubricants, labour wages or any other taxes etc. No extra payment shall be made for use of vehicle on holidays and Sundays. 20 The contractor shall ensure that all the meters particularly the Milometer/Speedometer and other devic es of vehicle are always in working condition. In case of any defect, the contractor at his own cost may rec tify the same. For the interim period the contractor shall arrange another vehicle so that the Railway's wor k does not get hampered. 21 The tenderer / contractor should submit the certificate regarding the calibration of Speedometer, as an d when demanded by the concerned depot in-charge i.e. SSE/PSI/CKP using the vehicle. 22 In the event of the breakdown of the vehicle en-route, the cost and responsibility of transporting the inc umbent of the vehicle to his destination shall be borne by the contractor. The contract shall be governed b y the Standard General Conditions of Contract. 23 First Aid Box with all necessary consumable items should be made available all the time by the Contrac tor and periodically he/they should inspect and recoup the same and necessary entry should also made in Log Book. 24 Frequent change of driver is not acceptable. Prior intimation to executive before changing of driver is m andatory. At least 3 days before change of driver, intimation is required to competent authority. 25 The vehicle driver must deposit any proof of identity like Voter card/Adhaar card etc. as an original cop y till completion of contract. It will return to concerned drivers after completion of currency of contract. 26 Firm must submit vehicle details for the tendered vehicle within 15 days after issuance of work Order/L OA. 27 The vehicle shall run in different sections over the jurisdictions of SSE/PSI/CKP under Sr. DEE/TRD/CKP, S.E.Railway and over CKP Division also if required. The vehicle should have validity to run in the state of O disha, West Bengal & Jharkhand. Sometimes overnight stay may be required at any of the stations. No acc ommodation or extra payment will be provided by the Railway for the driver & cleaner of the vehicle at an y place in such overnight stay. 28 The necessary modification in the body of the vehicle has to be done by the contractor to get the T&P e tc. to be loaded/transported in the truck as per depot’s requirement if any. The cost for such modification has to be borne by the contractor. 29 Driver of the vehicle should maintain Log book daily. Log book should be maintained properly on day-to -day basis and to be countersigned by concerned SSE of the jurisdiction for which sanctioned has been obt ained. Movement of the truck should be strictly regulated for carrying of departmental materials only. 30 Log book register being maintained duly showing of Vehicle No. and (1) Sr. No. (2) Date (3) From To (Ti me) (4) From To (Km) (5) Signature of the driver with date (6) Purpose for movement of the vehicle (7) Sig nature of officer. Entry in Log book register should be made on spot and instantly.

31 The rate in the tender schedule is including GST. Tenderer is required to quote the rate inclusive of all taxe s including GST for item of the tender schedule. 32 The contractor shall specifically indicate the SAC to ensure correct application of GST with Input Tax Cr edit (ITC) while submitting the bills for payment. ITC, if applicable shall be passed on to railway. 33 Vehicle as per this tender to be provided at PSI Depot/CKP. SSE/PSI/CKP will be consignee of this contract. DEE/TRD-II/CKP is the officer in charge of this contract. 34 The vehicle to be provided for the purpose is to be stationed at the concerned depot round the clock an d the driver for the vehicle to reside within 3KM distance from the base depot. 35 The driver to report the depot In-charge/ representative of concerned depot at 7.00 AM. daily and act a ccording to instruction of depot In-charge / representative of concerned depot during its normal duty hours . 36 Apart from normal maintenance work during normal duty hours, the vehicle will be utilized for break d own service (24x7) including night, hence the driver of the vehicle to turn up within 30 minutes of the call f rom the depot at any point of time. Residential address and contact number of the staff is to be informed t o depot in charge. On failing to report to depot in-charge / representative of concerned depot along with v ehicle within 30 minutes from the call during break down / any emergency, penalty of as mentioned in pen alty clause of Explanatory note will be imposed on contractor for each case. 37 All the repairs required for the vehicle engaged during the contract period to be carried out by the cont ractor and no extra cost will be paid for that. 38 The charges for the day’s contractor fail to provide vehicle will be deducted from the bill. Railway has t he right to close the contract at any time during the period of ongoing work. 39 The details documents in original and one set Xerox copy of the vehicle to be engaged (registration cer tificate, insurance, road permit, road tax, drivers’ driving license, identification proof of helpers) to be sub mitted to the consignee for necessary verification and vehicle is to be engaged after getting clearance fro m the consignee with intimation to this office with a set of verified documents. The contractor has to subm it all the above valid documents till the end of the contract. 40 There should be no pending dues / Cases against the vehicle with any organization and RTO. Declaratio n in this regard to be submitted to this office along with documents of the vehicle prior to engaging the ve hicle for the work. The tender may be terminated in the case of failure of the same. (B) Vehicle Particulars: - 1 The Commercially Registered vehicle should not be more than three years old. The age of the vehicle sh ould be counted from the date of publication of Notice Inviting Tender (NIT) in Gem Portal. It is to be certifi ed by concerned executives or supervisors at the time of submission of log book. 2 The rate includes all major/minor repairs serving of Commercially Registered vehicle, cost of fuel, lubrica nts and any other consumables required from time to time. Driver’s salary and all allowance, all taxes, dut ies, incidental charges, penalties etc. as imposed by Central/States/Local Government bodies for running o f Commercially Registered vehicles to be borne by the contractor without any liability on Railways. 3 Documents to be submitted by the contractor before execution of agreement. i. Valid driving license of the driver. ii. Valid insurance papers covering 3rd. party against accident etc. as per rules and statutory obligations. iii. Valid registration of the vehicle under commercial category. iv. Fitness certificate of the vehicle being provided.

4 The vehicle must be provided with fire extinguisher, relevant spares and tackles which may be required during running of the vehicle to handle minor problems. 5 The vehicle should be of Mahindra Bolero Camper Gold Zx or equivalent truck / vehicle having seating ca pacity of 05 (five) including driver with a carrier (Dalla) for material loading. 6 The contractor shall be completely responsible for safe running of Commercially Registered vehicle. Rail way will not be responsible for any loss, damage or accident to the vehicle / vehicle driver or any loss / da mage to any other party / asset caused or accident by the Commercially Registered vehicle. 7 The condition of the vehicle will be inspected by Sr. DEE/TRD/CKP or his authorized representative befor e engagement in Railway. Railway Administration shall be sole authority to reject the vehicle. (C) Penalty Clause: - 1 Vehicle supplied by agency without fuel will be treated as absent for that day. Rs.5,000/- per day penalt y will impose in no fuel situation. Driver should keep record of fueling being done. It must be ensured that vehicle should reach to office/depot only with full fueling condition. 2 Availability of mobile phones with the vehicle drivers is compulsory. Mobile should be complete with live SIM Card & Driver must response the phone as and when called by the controlling officer even at night in c ase of urgency. The cost of the same will be borne by the contractor and for which no extra payment is pa yable by the Railway. Non-compliance of this condition a penalty of Rs.5,000/- per day will be imposed. 3 Cost of FASTags/Night charges/Octroi/Toll Tax/ Parking Charges/Driver allowances or any other charges s hall be borne by the service provider. No extra charges will be payable other than finalized contract rate. Mandatory FASTags expenses shall be borne by the service provider, Railway will not bear any such type o f cost. Non-compliance of this condition a penalty of Rs.5,000/- per occasion will be imposed. 4 If the Commercially Registered vehicle is out of order, an alternative Commercially Registered vehicle in good condition has to be temporarily made available to the user, failing which a Commercially Registered vehicle will be hired from the open market and the actual payments made for the same along with a token penalty of Rs. 5,000/- per day will be recovered from the dues payable to the contractor. 5 The vehicle should be available to Railway with driver, cleaner, fuel etc. on all days of the week from 07. 00 AM to 24.00 AM. (Except weekly rest of depot). However, in case of accident / breakdown / derailment / failures / exigencies etc. if the truck is required on weekly rest of depot, the contractor should immediately made available the truck to Railways with driver, fuel, cleaner etc. Hence keeping in view the emergent sit uation, the driver cannot leave HQ in weekly rest. If the driver takes HQ leave the contactor should arrang e another driver. Failing which a penalty of Rs.5,000/- per case will be imposed in addition to non-payment for non-placement of vehicle on that particular day. Railway will inform the requirement of the vehicle to t he driver/contractor through Mobile Phone, SMS, Whatsapp etc. Driver should have a contact number pref erably a Mobile Phone on which Railway will contact when vehicle is required. No extra payment shall be made for extra hours, night allowance etc. Loading & unloading of materials will be done by the Railway st aff/labour or separate contractor. 6 Monthly salary payment to the drivers must be paid through online. Necessary documents for payment/r eceipt like RTGS/UPI/Pass book etc. to be submitted along with logbook. Any delay beyond monthly cycle f or drivers’ salary payment, per day penalty of Rs.5,000/- will be recovered till the date of salary payment. 7 In case of unsatisfactory service day to day of the following reasons, a deduction of the flat rate of Rs.50 00/- per day shall be made. i) Beyond one hour late from stipulated reporting time will be treated as absent. ii) Vehicle being more than three years old. iii) Driver not well disciplined, not appropriately dressed. iv) Vehicle not displaying, Govt. of India on Duty board on front and rear.

vi) Driver not having mobile phone in working condition. 8 If Driver will not carry with the vehicle necessary documents including his own valid driving license, a pe nalty of Rs.1,000/- will be imposed on being detected by any Railway Official. If caught by any other statut ory Authority for deficiency in any document all the penalties imposed by them will be borne by the Contra ctor only. 9 The vehicle, if not available for any movement at any time, a penalty of Rs.2,000/- will be imposed per c ase. For this penalty, the certificate of Railway representative is sufficient to impose. 10 If the vehicle unable to move out for any deficiency with vehicle/driver then a penalty of Rs.2,000/- will be levied per case. For this penalty, the certificate of Railway representative is sufficient to impose. 11 Vehicle made available more than 15 minutes late from the time advised by Railway representative for an y reason will be charged @ Rs.500/- per case. If the late is more than 30 minutes it will be treated as vehic le is not available and penalty will be charged. For this penalty, the certificate of Railway representative is sufficient to impose. 12 En-route breakdown for any reason due to poor maintenance of vehicle/insufficient fuel, consumables e tc. will be penalized at rate of Rs.2,000/- per case. 13 If the vehicle driver is found dirty, either in seating portion or in loading portion will be penalized Rs.20 0/- per case. 14 If the vehicle driver is found to be under influence of Alcohol or narcotics while on duty, penalty will be charged Rs.5,000/- per case. For this penalty, the certificate of Railway representative is sufficient to impo se. 15 Misbehavior by the vehicle driver/Contractor with any Railway Official will be charged by the Railway. V erbal complain of any Railway Officers/written complaint of any Railway Supervisor/Staff will be sufficient f or subject penalty and police action. Sr.DEE/TRD/CKP shall be Competent Authority to impose the penalty amount and is competent to decide whether the driver will be allowed to work further or not. 16 If the vehicle is used for purposes other than Railway work, then a penalty of Rs.5,000/- will be imposed per case. For this penalty, the certificate of Railway representative is sufficient to impose. 17 Failure to supply equivalent vehicle as substitute when the tendered vehicle is kept under repair will be penalized @ Rs.2,000/- per day. 18 The contractor shall take out and keep in force a policy and polices of insurance against all liabilities an d recognized risks in respect of accidents to persons employed by the contractor for the purpose of carryin g out the works of this contract. 19 Railway in no case is responsible for any legal matter arising due to State/Central Govt. laws in matter of employment of driver by own of the Commercially Registered vehicle or in respect of any other matter. (D) Company docs 1. The tenderer shall clearly specify whether the tender is submitted on his own (Proprietary Firm)or on be half of a Partnership Firm/Company/Joint Venture(JV)/Registered Society/ Registered Trust/Hindu Undivided Family(HUF)/Limited Liability Partnership (LLP)etc.The tenderer(s)shall enclose the attested copies of the c onstitution of their concern,and copy of PAN Card along with their tender.Tender Documents in such cases are to be signed by such persons as may be legally competent to sign them on behalf of the firm, compan y, association, trust or society,as the case may be - Following documents shall be submitted by the tenderer: (a)Sole Proprietorship Firm: The Bidder shall submit the notarized copy of the affidavit or any other docum ent issued from State / Central Government. (b)HUF:(i) A copy of notarized affidavit on Stamp Paper declaring that he who is submitting the tender on b ehalf of HUF is in the position of 'Karta' of Hindu Undivided Family (HUF)and he has the authority, power an

d consent given by other members to act on behalf of HUF. (c)Partnership Firm: The Bidder shall submit self-attested copies of (i) registered/notarized Partnership Dee d and (ii) Power of Attorney duly authorizing one or more of the partners of the firm or any other persons(s ), authorized by all the partners to act on behalf of the firm for said Bid/contract. (iii) All the partners of the partnership Firm shall submit a certificate in the prescribed format as per Annexure V A . Non submission of the certificate, or submission of certificate either not properly filled in, or in a format other than the pres cribed format shall lead to summary rejection of offer (d)Company registered under Companies Act2013:(i)The copies of MOA(Memorandum of Association)/AOA( Articles of Association)of the company (ii) A copy of Certificate of Incorporation (iii) A copy of Authorization/ Power of Attorney issued by the Company (backed by the resolution of Board of Directors) in favour of the i ndividual to sign the tender on behalf of the company and create liability against the company. (e) LLP (Limited Liability Partnership):(i) A copy of LLP Agreement (ii) A copy of Certificate of Incorporation ( iii) A copy of Power of Attorney/Authorization issued by the LLP in favour of the individual to sign the tender on behalf of the LLP and create liability against the LLP.(iv) An undertaking by all partners of the LLP that t hey are not blacklisted or debarred by Railways or any other Ministry / Department of the Govt. of India fro m participation in tenders / contracts as on the date of submission of bids, either in their individual capacit y or in any firm/LLP or JV in which they were / are partners/members. (v) All the partners of the partnership Firm shall submit a certificate in the prescribed format as per Annexure V A . Non submission of the certific ate, or submission of certificate either not properly filled in, or in a format other than the prescribed format shall lead to summary rejection of offer. (f) Registered Society & Registered Trust:(i) A copy of Certificate of Registration(ii) A copy of Memorandum of Association of Society/Trust Deed(iii) A copy of Power of Attorney in favour of the individual to sign the t ender documents and create liability against the Society/Trust.(iv) A copy of Rules & Regulations of the Soc iety. (E). The Contractor shall quote rates separately for both items of schedule. The rate quoted by the Contrac tor for each Schedule shall be treated as the lump-sum rate for that Schedule. The quoted rate shall there after be distributed among all constituent items in proportion to their departmental estimated cost, such t hat the overall percentage above or below the departmental estimate for the Schedule is uniformly applied to each item. The distributed rate for each item shall be binding on the Contractor and shall form the basis for execution and payment. (F). Tenderer must go through ATC, STC and GTC before quoting this tender. Conditions mentioned in ATC will prevail over STC and STC shall prevail over GTC. . 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
